claims.supporting_quote: pituitary adenylate cyclase-activating peptide (PACAP) has been shown to be increased ictally in jugular blood
changes of PACAP levels in migraine patients
There was a significant decrease in PACAP mRNA expression in the PBMCs of the migraine (M) group relative to the healthy control group.
Pre- and post-operative ... PACAP1-38 levels were significantly higher in patients with headache than in those without headache
PACAP-38 and CGRP levels in migraine patients during the ictal and interictal periods were higher than those in controls (p < 0.001).
PACAP-38 and CGRP levels in migraine patients with aura and without aura were higher than those in controls (p < 0.001).

Patients with moderate or severe migraine headache had elevated PACAP in the external jugular vein during headache (n = 15), that was reduced 1 h after treatment with sumatriptan 6 mg (n = 11), and further reduced interictally (n = 9).
